title: Tunnels of Blood
author: Darren Shan
note: conf=0.97; Verified as book 3 of the Cirque du Freak series (also marketed as "The Saga of Darren Shan"), by Darren Shan. Goodreads lists it as "Tunnels of Blood (Cirque du Freak, #3)"; US editions are subtitled "Book 3 in the Saga of Darren Shan" (ISBN 9780316606080). Canonical title is simply "Tunnels of Blood"; the "Cirque Du Freak:" prefix is a US publisher series branding.
